title: Pairing Response
description: Response of POST /__remote_everything_pair: redeeming an invitation. It is the one request that arrives without a credential — the invitation is what it carries instead — and both shapes answer it the same way, so a paired device is a paired device whichever kind of gateway it paired with.

ok.description: Always true for a valid pairing response.

certificate_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the issued client certificate.

credential_format.description: Credential encoding format. Only pkcs12 is supported.

credential_pkcs12.description: Base64-encoded PKCS#12 archive containing the client certificate and private key, encrypted with the credential_password the request carried. The same (device_name, credential_password) asked again during the pending window is answered with this same credential, so a pairing that was interrupted can be retried.

pending_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant when the pending authorization expires.
